title: Interior Wall & Ceiling Painting
description: Flawless surface micro-repair, acoustic ceiling refinishing, and architectural eggshell or satin coating applied with razor-sharp laser lines.
imageAlt: An expansive modern open-concept living room bathed in natural morning light, featuring pristine off-white matte painted walls, flawless crisp ceiling corners, and refined royal cobalt accent details with fine wood flooring.

title: Exterior Painting & Weatherproofing
description: Multi-stage pressure wash prep, elastomeric bonding caulking, and high-build weather-shield coatings built to repel extreme UV and coastal humidity.
imageAlt: The exterior facade of a luxury coastal residence painted with premium architectural slate blue and bright white trim, surrounded by manicured landscaping, highlighting weather-sealed siding and durable finish under bright sunlight.

title: Cabinet Refinishing & Restoration
description: Complete conversion-varnish spray system. On-site spray tent extraction for boxes paired with off-site baking booth treatment for cabinet faces.
imageAlt: Gourmet kitchen cabinetry undergoing artisan factory-smooth lacquer finishing, deep midnight blue shaker doors with brass brushed handles, gleaming under high-end recessed ceiling lighting.

title: Roofs & Gutters Protective Coating
description: High-albedo reflective elastomeric coatings that reduce thermal heat gain by up to 35%, waterproof seams, and rejuvenate metal gutter linings.
imageAlt: Aerial view of a commercial modern flat roof and seamless gutter system receiving reflective elastomeric cooling sealant applied by professional technicians with specialized high-volume spray equipment.

title: Carpentry & Trim Repair
description: True painting excellence requires solid substrate. Our in-house finish carpenters replace dry rot, build custom wainscoting, and install baseboards.
imageAlt: Close up artisan view of intricate historical wood crown moulding and architectural wainscoting being carefully repaired, filled, and hand-sanded with carpentry hand tools prior to paint priming.

title: Deck & Fence Deep Staining
description: Deep-conditioning natural oils and UV-blocking hybrid pigments designed to nourish aging hardwoods, prevent mold penetration, and eliminate splintering.
imageAlt: Architectural cedar outdoor deck and privacy perimeter fence treated with a warm honey teak penetrating oil stain, showing deep natural wood grain textures overlooking a lush residential garden.
